# AM Growth Partners

> AM Growth Partners is an education growth consulting and execution firm based in Madhapur, Hyderabad, India. We help educational institutions attract the right enquiries, convert more admissions, retain existing students, and build sustainable growth systems.

## Services

Four connected solutions. One growth partner.

- [Positioning & Brand Strategy](https://amgrowthp.com/#brand-strategy): School branding and positioning: brand audits, competitor and catchment analysis, parent perception research, value proposition and messaging strategy.
- [Demand Generation](https://amgrowthp.com/#demand-generation): School admissions marketing: admissions marketing strategy, Meta Ads, Google Ads, local SEO, landing page optimisation and lead-quality tracking.
- [Admission Conversion](https://amgrowthp.com/#admission-conversion): School admissions consulting: funnel audits, admissions CRM setup, counsellor and telecaller training, structured follow-ups, campus visit optimisation and leadership dashboards.
- [Retention & Parent Experience](https://amgrowthp.com/#student-retention): Student retention consulting: withdrawal analysis, parent satisfaction and feedback systems, parent communication and net enrolment growth monitoring.

Engagement philosophy: Build → Grow → Scale.

## Who We Help

- K-12 schools (CBSE, ICSE, IB)
- Private colleges and universities
- Coaching institutes (IIT-JEE, NEET, Civil Services)
- EdTech and higher-education brands
